note: The viewer schema is declared by hand because raw `meta` shapes vary between rounds: the datasets-server infers `meta` as `{factory, generator, round}` from the two records in `batch-r01.jsonl`; four more thin-meta records appear in `batch-r02.jsonl` and `batch-r98.jsonl`, while later shards also carry `domain`, `stack`, `theme`, `kind`, `seed`, `designed` and `lane`. Declaring the union fixes the index without rewriting a single historical raw record.

features.name: meta
features.note: key-bag: `factory`, `generator`, `round` on every record, plus `domain`, `stack` (8004), `kind` (6332), `seed` (6330), `designed` (6330), `lane` (5440), `theme` (1674) and `product`, `mechanic` (2) on subsets

disclosures.summary: Two records are leftover-mill BuildKit cache-mount episodes that were published into this dataset by mistake: their ids use the `dbc-` prefix, their `meta.kind` is `designed`, and they carry `meta.product` / `meta.mechanic` keys no other record has. Their `meta.factory` is dest-stamped `api-contract-migration-factory`, so a factory-stamp check cannot see them. They are kept exactly as generated; the other 8010 records are API contract-migration episodes.

Six early records, two each in `batch-r01.jsonl`, `batch-r02.jsonl` and `batch-r98.jsonl`, are genuine contract-migration episodes with a thinner `meta` of only `factory`, `generator` and `round`. The two in `batch-r01.jsonl` are the schema-inference source; the other four share the same thin shape. Together they explain why the cast against wider later shards failed. They are kept exactly as generated.

disclosures: All 8012 records are stamped `meta.generator` `grok-4.6` and `meta.factory` `api-contract-migration-factory`, over rounds 1 through 4006.
Every step publishes a public `decision_basis`. There are no hidden `thought` or `internal_reasoning` fields.
